# no-blanks-blockquote

- ID: `MD028`
- Category: Blockquotes
- Default: on, severity warning
- Fixable: no
- Tags: `blockquote`, `whitespace`

No blank line sits between two blockquotes.

## Why

Parsers disagree about whether a blank line ends a blockquote, so the quotes may
render as one or as two.

## Options

This rule has no options.

## Fix

There is no automatic fix. Put \> on the blank line to join the quotes, or text
between them to keep them apart.

## Example

This document breaks the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

> Back up your files before you upgrade.

> Then run the installer.
```

gomdlint reports:

```text
4:1 Blank line inside blockquote separates it into multiple blockquotes
```

This document follows the rule:

```markdown
# Guide

> Back up your files before you upgrade.
>
> Then run the installer.
```

## Configure

Under `rules`, `no-blanks-blockquote: false` turns the rule off and
`no-blanks-blockquote: error` reports its findings as errors. The flag
`--disable no-blanks-blockquote` turns it off for one run.

## Silence one line

```markdown
<!-- markdownlint-disable-next-line no-blanks-blockquote -->
```
